builds.name: Reference: Mana scaling
builds.goal: Reference for Ryze: establish a repeatable reference
builds.hypothesis: A short-range spell-combo mage who spreads Flux, resets Q through other spells and gains movement by sequencing runes. Record Flux spreads, Q resets and mana-supported AP interactions. Compare a single target versus waves/chains; the movement rune sequence must actually be executed. Finite Rod stacks and a transformed mana item test later AP/mana-supported sequences.
testPlan: Kit question for Ryze: Record Flux spreads, Q resets and mana-supported AP interactions. Compare a single target versus waves/chains; the movement rune sequence must actually be executed.

Start with the early core (Rod early if the timer fits, then Archangel) plus appropriate boots at matched gold. Record level, actual ability ranks, forms, resource and item transformations; six-item results do not establish lane strength. Use your intended lane or jungle role; jungle starters and early consumables are outside the final six slots.

Use this as the control for the other three routes. Run three repeatable trials of a short trade and a ten-second fight. Record damage actually landed, attacks/casts, misses, remaining resource and survival. Record available/max mana and any transformed mana-item state.

Measure the actual interaction before granting item/rune procs: Finite Rod stacks and a transformed mana item test later AP/mana-supported sequences. Test once stationary, then with a moving opponent and a fixed incoming damage pattern.

Q evidence: Passively, Ryze's other basic abilities reset the cooldown of Overload and charge a rune. When Ryze casts Overload with 2 runes charged, he gains a brief burst of Move Speed.

On cast, Ryze throws a charge of pure energy in a line, dealing damage to the first enemy struck. If the target has Flux on it, Overload deals extra damage and bounces to nearby enemies with Flux. Keep finite champion/item/rune stacks explicit. Use Practice Tool, a custom match or your own replay; no numerical adapter is available for this champion.
